projects.name: Formatos Integraficos
projects.description: Landing page developed for a SUNAT-authorized printing company in Peru, focused on attracting clients who require printing of fiscal formats such as invoices, proformas, and POS vouchers. The system implements a modular component architecture with Astro, integrating a quote form that automatically redirects to WhatsApp with preloaded data. Includes SEO optimizations with meta tags for Open Graph and Twitter Cards, automatic sitemap generation, and a responsive structure with Tailwind CSS. Technically relevant for its performance approach through static generation and direct integration with business communication channels.

projects.name: Free QR Generator
projects.description: Free and accessible web platform for generating personalized QR codes. Allows creating QR codes for URLs, WhatsApp, WiFi, and plain text, with customization options for size, color, and logo. Includes export in multiple formats (PNG, JPG, PDF, SVG), multi-language support (ES, EN, PT), dark/light mode and responsive design. Developed with React + TypeScript and Node.js + Express, optimized to be fast and easy to use for anyone at no cost.

projects.name: Lords of Memes and Magic

experience.title: Full Stack Developer — Makez (Startup)
bullets: Built a complete CRM dashboard with Angular 21 (standalone components, signals) consuming a REST API with JWT authentication, route guards, and responsive UI with PrimeNG and Tailwind CSS.
Implemented commercial KPI visualization (conversion, revenue, leads, response rate) with date filters and Chart.js charts in general mode and per-client comparative views.
Designed REST API backend with NestJS 11 and domain-modular architecture (Auth, Leads, Sales, Chatbot, Metrics, Integrations) following Clean Architecture with MongoDB and Mongoose.
Built a chatbot engine with configurable flows and API-type steps: orchestration of external HTTP calls with multiple authentication (Bearer, Basic, API Key) and data extraction with JSONPath.
Integrated META API (WhatsApp Business) for message automation using official templates, connecting the chatbot to real communication channels.
Developed a conversion-focused sales landing page with React and Tailwind CSS for end-customer product presentation.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer — Polo E-commerce
bullets: Architected and developed a full stack e-commerce platform with 3+ active clients (entrepreneurs, startups, and banking entities).
Frontend: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS with Context API; shopping cart, authentication, admin panel, and responsive UI (Lighthouse > 90).
Backend: Node.js + NestJS + MongoDB/Mongoose; REST API with JWT, Tupay payment integration, order and inventory management.
DevOps: Vercel deployment, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, technical documentation, and automated testing.

experience.title: Video Game Developer — Unity 2D

Configured full technical SEO (OG meta, canonical, Google Analytics, Google Maps embed) and full-stack Vercel deployment with SPA rewrites.

featuredProjects.title: ArmalyTech — Desktop Inventory System
